GOV-SPEC-001.title: Missing task spec
GOV-SPEC-001.why_failed: Compiler cannot bind obligations without a declared capability/proof/guardrails spec.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Create docs/qc/specs/<task-id>.task.spec.json from template with all required fields.

disallowed_workarounds: Reusing another task's spec without updating task_id and scope

GOV-SPEC-002.title: Invalid task spec schema
GOV-SPEC-002.why_failed: Spec JSON is malformed or missing required schema keys.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Fix schema violations reported by compiler and rerun.

disallowed_workarounds: Deleting failing fields to silence parser
Downgrading schema checks in compiler policy

GOV-SPEC-003.title: Missing control truth table
GOV-SPEC-003.why_failed: Spec omitted control semantics required for deterministic behavior proof.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Add controls[] entries with default/range/off_semantics/on_semantics.

disallowed_workarounds: Replacing controls list with free text
Marking control obligations N/A without diff support

GOV-SPEC-004.title: Missing deterministic fixtures
GOV-SPEC-004.why_failed: Proof section is missing fixed fixtures and seed used for deterministic reruns.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Declare built-in fixtures and fixed seed in proof.fixtures/proof.seed.

GOV-SPEC-005.title: Governance and product changes mixed
GOV-SPEC-005.why_failed: task_type=governance-change must be isolated from product implementation files.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Split governance and product changes into separate tasks/commits/specs.

disallowed_workarounds: Marking product files as out_of_scope while still staged
Relaxing policy freeze in same task
GOV-SPEC-005.recheck_protocol: restage split slices then run gov:check for each

GOV-SPEC-006.title: Guardrails missing
GOV-SPEC-006.why_failed: Spec must explicitly declare skip/fixme/contract-edit guardrails.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Set guardrails.allow_fixme=false and allow_skip=false unless governance-approved.

GOV-SPEC-007.title: Invalid task_type value
GOV-SPEC-007.why_failed: task.spec.json uses unsupported task_type; compiler cannot bind obligations deterministically.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Use one allowed task_type from obligation-rules.json (feature|bugfix|refactor|governance-change|qc).
If task_type is "fix", replace it with "bugfix" and rerun compiler.

disallowed_workarounds: Skipping compiler because schema is 'close enough'

GOV-BIND-001.title: Unbound changed file
GOV-BIND-001.why_failed: Changed file has no contract binding in obligation rules.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Add explicit path binding and obligations for the file category in obligation rules.

disallowed_workarounds: Marking task as docs-only while staging code
required_evidence: binding rule update or restaged file set

GOV-BIND-002.title: Audio change without audio obligations
GOV-BIND-002.why_failed: Audio-impacting diff requires audio gates and audio oracle evidence.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Run required audio gates and include oracle artifacts for transparency/safety/continuity.

GOV-BIND-003.title: Control change without control obligations
GOV-BIND-003.why_failed: Control mapping changes require control truthfulness oracles.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Add control oracles for off/on semantics and low-end continuity.

disallowed_workarounds: Replacing behavior checks with DOM class assertions

GOV-BIND-004.title: Policy freeze violation
GOV-BIND-004.why_failed: Governance files were modified by non-governance task type.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Retype task as governance-change or unstage governance files.

disallowed_workarounds: Silently editing contracts in product task
Changing compiler rules to permit this in same task

GOV-BIND-005.title: Persistence change without roundtrip obligation
GOV-BIND-005.why_failed: Persistence diff requires deterministic save/load behavior proof.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Add persistence_roundtrip oracle artifact bound to tree SHA.

disallowed_workarounds: Using only unit mocks without behavior hash

GOV-BIND-006.title: Spec declared scope does not match staged diff
GOV-BIND-006.why_failed: Staged files are outside capability.in_scope declarations.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Update in_scope or split staged files into separate scoped task.

disallowed_workarounds: Broad wildcard scope with no intent

GOV-PROOF-001.title: Missing proof manifest
GOV-PROOF-001.why_failed: Required machine proof manifest file is absent.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Create docs/qc/proofs/<task-id>/proof.manifest.json with required fields.

GOV-PROOF-002.title: Required suite skipped or fixme present
GOV-PROOF-002.why_failed: Required obligations cannot be skipped or marked fixme.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Remove skip/fixme from required suites and provide real pass/fail result.

required_evidence: required suite logs with zero skip/fixme

GOV-PROOF-003.title: Non-deterministic proof run
GOV-PROOF-003.why_failed: Repeated run with same seed/fixtures produced mismatched hash.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Remove randomness and bind run to fixed seed and fixture set.

disallowed_workarounds: Overwriting one run hash with another
GOV-PROOF-003.recheck_protocol: rerun deterministic harness twice and compare hashes

GOV-PROOF-004.title: Required proof artifact missing
GOV-PROOF-004.why_failed: A required oracle artifact file is missing.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Generate the missing oracle artifact from harness and store in required path.

disallowed_workarounds: Marking missing artifact as assumed pass

GOV-PROOF-005.title: Proof artifact hash mismatch
GOV-PROOF-005.why_failed: Artifact declared hash does not match raw evidence content.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Regenerate artifact and recompute hash from raw output.

GOV-PROOF-006.title: Artifact subject mismatch
GOV-PROOF-006.why_failed: Artifact subject_sha does not match the staged subject hash being validated.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Regenerate proof artifacts for current staged subject and update subject_sha.

required_evidence: artifact subject_sha equal to compiler subject_sha

GOV-PROOF-007.title: Mutation checks missing
GOV-PROOF-007.why_failed: Critical control tasks require mutation-fail evidence.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Run mutation scenario and attach failing mutant evidence in oracle artifact.

GOV-PROOF-008.title: Proof manifest missing required fields
GOV-PROOF-008.why_failed: Manifest does not include mandatory metadata or gate matrix.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Populate manifest fields from template and include gate outcomes and contract matrix.

GOV-PROOF-009.title: Manual oracle evidence is not allowed
GOV-PROOF-009.why_failed: Oracle artifact declares manual harness evidence, which is self-asserted and non-deterministic for compiler trust.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Generate oracle artifacts from a deterministic machine harness and record harness_version accordingly.
Attach raw machine output files and matching hashes in oracle artifacts.

disallowed_workarounds: Writing narrative evidence without machine output
required_evidence: raw artifact produced by deterministic harness
GOV-PROOF-009.recheck_protocol: regenerate oracle artifacts from harness, then rerun gov:check

GOV-AUDIO-001.title: Off state is not transparent
GOV-AUDIO-001.why_failed: Bypass/off output differs from baseline beyond allowed epsilon.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Implement true bypass topology or transparent crossfade path.

disallowed_workarounds: Setting neutral params while DSP still alters signal
GOV-AUDIO-001.recheck_protocol: run off_transparent oracle and verify delta <= max_abs_error

GOV-AUDIO-002.title: On state has no audible effect
GOV-AUDIO-002.why_failed: Enabled state did not cross minimum audible delta threshold.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Fix control wiring so enabled path modulates intended processing.

disallowed_workarounds: Changing threshold in same product task
GOV-AUDIO-002.recheck_protocol: run on_audible oracle and verify delta >= min_delta

GOV-AUDIO-003.title: Low-end 0->1% explosion
GOV-AUDIO-003.why_failed: Near-zero control sweep exceeded continuity budget.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Apply bounded curve mapping near zero and verify monotonic increments.
Use smoothing or log taper that preserves low-end continuity.

disallowed_workarounds: Adding limiter only to hide mapping error
GOV-AUDIO-003.recheck_protocol: run low_end_continuity oracle with dense points (0,0.25,0.5,1,2,5,10..100)

GOV-AUDIO-004.title: Control response non-monotonic
GOV-AUDIO-004.why_failed: Measured effect curve reverses direction unexpectedly.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Correct transfer mapping to preserve declared monotonic trend.

disallowed_workarounds: Declaring curve custom without documenting expected inversions
GOV-AUDIO-004.recheck_protocol: run monotonicity oracle and verify no forbidden inversion

GOV-AUDIO-005.title: Clip guard violated
GOV-AUDIO-005.why_failed: Render introduced clipping or exceeded peak budget.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Reduce default gain staging and enforce bounded internal levels.

GOV-AUDIO-005.recheck_protocol: run clip_guard oracle and verify clip_count==0 and peak<=max_peak

GOV-AUDIO-006.title: Unsafe default audio profile

acceptable_recipes.summary: Tune default params to conservative values and remeasure.

disallowed_workarounds: Changing threshold profile in same task
Marking defaults as intentionally aggressive without approval
GOV-AUDIO-006.recheck_protocol: run default_safety oracle and compare against profile thresholds

GOV-AUDIO-007.title: Deterministic render hash mismatch
GOV-AUDIO-007.why_failed: Render hash changed between repeated deterministic runs.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Eliminate random/time-dependent sources in render path.

GOV-AUDIO-007.recheck_protocol: run deterministic render twice with same fixtures and compare hashes

GOV-AUDIO-008.title: Bypass is placebo CPU path
GOV-AUDIO-008.why_failed: DSP remains active in bypass path and violates bypass CPU policy.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Use true bypass/disconnect or low-cost transparent branch with verified CPU delta.

disallowed_workarounds: Masking CPU load with coarse benchmark
GOV-AUDIO-008.recheck_protocol: run bypass_cpu oracle and verify active_vs_bypass CPU delta

GOV-CTRL-001.title: Control not bound to engine
GOV-CTRL-001.why_failed: UI control changed but no observable engine parameter binding evidence.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Wire control through typed engine API and prove effect with control oracle.

disallowed_workarounds: Local placeholder variables not wired to audio
GOV-CTRL-001.recheck_protocol: run control_binding oracle and verify parameter telemetry changes

GOV-CTRL-002.title: Toggle truthfulness mismatch
GOV-CTRL-002.why_failed: Toggle UI state does not match declared off/on audio semantics.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Align toggle state with engine bypass/enable behavior and prove off/on oracles.

GOV-CTRL-003.title: Control endpoint behavior invalid
GOV-CTRL-003.why_failed: Control min/max endpoints fail declared expected behavior.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Fix endpoint mapping and verify endpoint oracle metrics.

disallowed_workarounds: Shrinking visible range in UI only
Changing defaults to avoid endpoint checks
GOV-CTRL-003.recheck_protocol: run endpoint oracle across declared min/max

GOV-CTRL-004.title: Runtime default mismatch
GOV-CTRL-004.why_failed: Runtime defaults differ from capability declaration.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Align declared default and runtime default or split into migration task.

disallowed_workarounds: Masking default mismatch in UI initialization
GOV-CTRL-004.recheck_protocol: run default_alignment oracle and compare declared/runtime values

GOV-CTRL-005.title: UI-only evidence submitted
GOV-CTRL-005.why_failed: Control proof bundle lacks audio-behavior evidence.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Add audio oracles to prove control behavior, not only DOM state.

disallowed_workarounds: Asserting visual toggle equals functional success
Marking audio oracle N/A for control task

GOV-CTRL-006.title: Persistence control mismatch
GOV-CTRL-006.why_failed: Control state after save/load does not match pre-save state.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Fix serialization/deserialization and prove roundtrip hash equality.

GOV-CTRL-006.recheck_protocol: run persistence_roundtrip oracle with pre/post behavior hash

GOV-PERF-002.title: Worklet p99 budget exceeded
GOV-PERF-002.why_failed: Benchmark oracle reported p99 process duration above block budget.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Optimize processor path or reduce default workload until p99 <= budget.

disallowed_workarounds: Raising p99 threshold in same product task
GOV-PERF-002.recheck_protocol: run benchmark_worklet_budget oracle and verify p99 <= block budget

GOV-PROC-001.title: No staged changes
GOV-PROC-001.why_failed: Compiler validates staged content; nothing is staged.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Stage intended files, then run compiler again.

disallowed_workarounds: Running compiler against unstaged working tree and committing later

GOV-PROC-002.title: Governance check failed
GOV-PROC-002.why_failed: A required command obligation exited non-zero.
GOV-PROC-002.root_cause_reminder: Solve the real cause. Do not modify gates or assertions just to force PASS.
GOV-PROC-002.operator_escalation: If remediation reveals a real contract/runtime conflict, pause and request operator guidance.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Fix root cause in code/tests; rerun failed command obligation.

disallowed_workarounds: Removing failing gate from obligation rules in same task

GOV-PROC-003.title: Compiler internal error
GOV-PROC-003.why_failed: Compiler crashed before completing all phases.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Fix compiler/runtime issue in a governance-change task and rerun.

GOV-PROC-004.title: Attestation mismatch
GOV-PROC-004.why_failed: Commit wrapper expected PASS verdict but received non-PASS or mismatched task/tree.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Rerun compiler, ensure PASS, then commit with matching spec and staged tree.

GOV-PROC-005.title: Missing commit message for gov:commit
GOV-PROC-005.why_failed: Commit wrapper requires explicit conventional commit message.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Provide -m "type(scope): description" to gov:commit.

GOV-PROC-006.title: Missing commit attestation trailer
GOV-PROC-006.why_failed: Commit must include Gov-Task and Gov-Attestation trailers.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Commit through gov:commit so trailers are attached automatically.

GOV-PROC-007.title: Repeated blocking failure requires operator guidance
GOV-PROC-007.why_failed: The same blocking command diagnostic repeated across remediation attempts; likely contract/runtime conflict or unresolved root cause.
GOV-PROC-007.root_cause_reminder: Do not keep patching around the symptom. Stop and escalate with evidence.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Create operator-guidance artifact with logs and conflict rationale, request decision, then continue with that direction.

disallowed_workarounds: Continuing blind retries with same failing command
Relaxing gate semantics to make text say PASS
GOV-PROC-007.recheck_protocol: request operator guidance, apply approved direction, then rerun npm run gov:check -- --spec <same-spec>

GOV-PROC-008.title: Stand-down lock active
GOV-PROC-008.why_failed: Mid-task termination lock is active; product task execution is paused until operator reactivation.

acceptable_recipes.summary: Run stand-down protocol, ensure report artifact exists, and wait for explicit operator reactivation.

disallowed_workarounds: Continuing edits while stand-down is active
GOV-PROC-008.recheck_protocol: after operator clears stand-down lock, rerun npm run gov:check -- --spec <same-spec>

GOV-ROLE-001.title: Governance task requires observer role
GOV-ROLE-001.why_failed: task_type=governance-change is observer-only and cannot run in default CA mode.

acceptable_recipes.summary: CA stands down and hands off governance work to observer.
Observer reruns compiler with --allow-governance-change (or GOV_ALLOW_GOVERNANCE_CHANGE=1).

disallowed_workarounds: Relabeling governance files as product work
GOV-ROLE-001.recheck_protocol: observer runs gov:check with --allow-governance-change and same spec
